newsitem.title: USA: Melville to change name to CVS Corp.
newsitem.headline: Melville to change name to CVS Corp.

text.p: Melville Corp said on Wednesday that it began trading as CVS Corp, reflecting the company's new focus on its drugstore business.
Melville earlier this month spun off its Footstar Inc footwear retailing business.
Melville shares will automatically become CVS shares, assuming shareholders approve the name change in a November 19 vote.
Thomas Ryan, president and chief executive of CVS, has been named vice chaiman and chief operating officer. Stanley Goldstein will continue as chairman and chief executive.
The CVS drugstore chain now represents all of Melville's continuing operations, while Linens 'n Things and Bob's Stores are classified as discontinued operations.
Melville started accounting for Bob's Stores and Linens 'n Things as discontinued operations as part of a restructuring that included the spin-off of Footstar.
The reorganization that led to the focus on CVS also involved the sale of Marshalls, Wilsons, Kay Bee Toys and This End Up.
The company has not yet announced its plans for Linens 'n Things and Bob's Stores.
